name: PB-01: Add all 14 Design tab components to a new page and verify each appears on canvas

steps.name: Navigate directly to Page Builder list (/admin/landing-pages)
Wait for visible: Page title input in modal
Fill "Page title" with "PB Components vir bene 1779727947486"
Wait for selector getByRole('button', { name: 'Create page' })
Create new Page Builder page: "PB Components vir bene 1779727947486"
Wait for selector getByRole('button', { name: 'Back to Page Builder main' })
Wait for visible: Back to Page Builder main button
Wait for Page Builder editor to load
Click Edit to enter edit mode
Switch to Design tab in left panel
Wait for selector getByRole('button', { name: /Static Editable elements/i })
Wait for selector getByRole('button', { name: /Static Editable elements/i })
Wait for selector getByRole('button', { name: /Dynamic Elements managed/i })
Drag "Text" from Design panel to canvas
Assert "Text" component is visible on canvas
Drag "Button" from Design panel to canvas
Assert "Button" component is visible on canvas
Wait for selector locator('[data-marker="pageBuilderDesignContent"]').locator('[aria-roledescription="draggable"]').and(getByRole('button', { name: 'Image', exact: true }))
Drag "Image" from Design panel to canvas
Assert "Image" component is visible on canvas
Wait for selector locator('[data-marker="pageBuilderDesignContent"]').locator('[aria-roledescription="draggable"]').and(getByRole('button', { name: 'Video', exact: true }))
Click: Cancel button in picker dialog
Dismiss component picker dialog (Cancel) — component placement initiated
Drag "Video" from Design panel to canvas
Wait for selector locator('[data-marker="pageBuilderDesignContent"]').locator('[aria-roledescription="draggable"]').and(getByRole('button', { name: 'Divider', exact: true }))
Drag "Divider" from Design panel to canvas
Assert "Divider" component is visible on canvas
Drag "Dynamic Text" from Design panel to canvas
Assert "Dynamic Text" component is visible on canvas
Wait for selector locator('[data-marker="pageBuilderDesignContent"]').locator('[aria-roledescription="draggable"]').and(getByRole('button', { name: /Image\ &\ Text\ Card$/i }))
Drag "Image & Text Card" from Design panel to canvas
Assert "Image & Text Card" component is visible on canvas
Drag "Text & Button Card" from Design panel to canvas
Drag "Image, Text & Button Card" from Design panel to canvas
Drag "Profile Card" from Design panel to canvas
Drag "Dynamic Card" from Design panel to canvas
Drag "Dynamic Strip" from Design panel to canvas
Wait for selector locator('[data-marker="pageBuilderDesignContent"]').locator('[aria-roledescription="draggable"]').and(getByRole('button', { name: /Promoted\ Content\ Strip$/i }))
Drag "Promoted Content Strip" from Design panel to canvas
Drag "Promoted Banner" from Design panel to canvas
Wait for selector getByRole('button', { name: 'Back to Page Builder main' })
Click getByRole('button', { name: 'Back to Page Builder main' })
Click: Back to Page Builder main
Click Back to Page Builder main → navigate to list
Assert page "PB Components vir bene 1779727947486" is present in the Page Builder list
